name: Watch Management
description: Add and remove GitHub users and repositories from watch list

scenarios.description: User searches for and adds a GitHub user via debounced search

template.introduction:
**Search and Watch User**

User types in search box, waits for results, and clicks to watch.

events.feed.github.search_users_sent: [3] GitHub search users request sent via TIPC: query={{query}}, perPage={{per_page}}
events.feed.github.search_users_received: [4] GitHub search results received: {{user_count}} users found
events.feed.watched_activity.loaded: [10] Activity refreshed: {{total_commits}} commits from {{unique_repos}} repos in {{duration_ms}}ms

template.summary:
**Result:** User discovered via search and added to watch list
- 300ms debounce delay
- Search cleared after adding

scenarios.description: User searches for and adds a GitHub repository via debounced search

template.introduction:
**Search and Watch Repository**

User types in search box, waits for results, and clicks to watch.

events.feed.github.search_repos_sent: [3] GitHub search repos request sent via TIPC: query={{query}}, perPage={{per_page}}
events.feed.github.search_repos_received: [4] GitHub search results received: {{repo_count}} repos found
events.feed.search.results_rendered: [5] Search results rendered: {{result_count}} {{result_type}} displayed with metadata
events.feed.watched_activity.loaded: [10] Activity refreshed: {{total_commits}} commits from {{unique_repos}} repos in {{duration_ms}}ms

template.summary:
**Result:** Repository discovered via search and added to watch list
- 300ms debounce delay
- Shows language, stars, description
- Search cleared after adding
